structured.answer: I haven't decided; I'll ask my son. The page says the cheapest place is פסגות, with the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A)", leaving 86,045 ₪ after 10 years from 70,000 ₪ put in, but that's with the 7% the page put in itself. Leumi, which I know, would leave 82,968 ₪.
